item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent
item.description:
Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent is now generally available. It provides a built-in Azure Copilot capability for investigating and resolving operational issues, and is available through Azure Copilot and Support.

  • Source: Azure Updates
